name: com.mindattic.telemetry
description: Raw, replayable turn/event telemetry for games: TelemetryUnity.Begin("YourGame") starts a session (per battle/level/run, your call), RecordTurn/RecordEvent append to it, Finish closes it. One append-only NDJSON file per session, crash-safe by construction, genericized across any game's own state/command/event shapes so it's never tied to one game's schema. Output goes to R:\Telemetry (falls back under Documents\MindAttic\Telemetry). Editor and development builds only by default — define MINDATTIC_TELEMETRY to force it into a build.
